t_advice_summary_textbox.text: they put all of the 1x gnomes to the left and all of the x5 to the right then swapped each quarter. they also said when theres the number 0, no matter what gnome was picked, it still would have given you 0 points

vb_textbox.text: My advice is take a chance! I worked with patterns so if i got 2 right on the left i'd switch to the right. Try and spot the trends when you're doing 1x with one side vs 5x with another side. Also, don't worry about the 0's!
